body: OCDs has pvp kdr of 3.04 and a pvp kdr of around 2.9.  He seems to be a nice guy whom requested me to help him in finding a team.  I vouch for him as based on his statistics and his willingness to dedicate time on the server he would make a great candidate for any team.  He wished to say this concerning himself ; "Hello, i am new to this server but am looking for a team. As i think my team dont play here anymore. My past team is Sagrevyum. I speak Spanish and english. My profile is here: www.avicus.net/OCDs. I got aagrant to write this out as i am unable to write this post at the moment. My mic is broken atm :/ but i am a very good listener. And will buy a mic soon. Ty for reading I will be able to use forums soon i think. (Idk how to register) Also my discord is OCDs#9238"
